name: Rakuen no Natsu
source:
Hero is a 3rd grade high school student in a small rural town. He is surrounded by childhood friends and lives happily. By summer vacations he starts to think about future and long-life relations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是一个乡村小镇的三年级高中生。他周围都是儿时的朋友，生活幸福。到了暑假，他开始思考未来和长期的关系。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
